contract: Local SQLite session discovery with parent_id and time_updated; selective deletion tested with database readback.

observations: Session rows use id, parent_id, title, directory and millisecond time_updated.
Message and todo rows reference session_id. Part rows reference message_id and session_id.

generation.method: Manually generated synthetic values using only the fixed source output field names and value types. No upstream source code or user session content is copied.
generation.privacy: All IDs, titles, timestamps and /fixtures paths are invented. No credentials, private paths or real conversation records are included.
generation.environment: Format derivation only; no OpenCode binary was installed or executed.
generation.scope: Local discovery row decoding; tests/native-trash.test.ts separately exercises synthetic SQLite deletion and preservation. No upstream binary readback is claimed.

fixtures.scenario: A root and its child, deliberately older first.
